description.p: Soplos System Service shows what the systemd services of the computer are doing and lets you control them: start, stop, restart, enable and disable services and timers, read the system and per-service logs, see how long the system takes to boot and what slows it down, and get suggestions about what this computer does not need. Every change is recorded in a history and can be undone. A diagnosis page tells what is broken, based on what systemd and the package system report, and repairs it with apt, dpkg or systemctl after showing what will change.

Soplos System Service muestra el estado de los servicios systemd del equipo y permite controlarlos: iniciar, detener, reiniciar, habilitar y deshabilitar servicios y temporizadores, leer el registro del sistema y de cada servicio, ver cuánto tarda el arranque y qué lo ralentiza, y obtener sugerencias sobre lo que este equipo no necesita. Cada cambio queda registrado en el historial y puede deshacerse. Una página de diagnóstico indica qué está roto, basándose en lo que informan systemd y el sistema de paquetes, y lo repara con apt, dpkg o systemctl mostrando primero qué cambiará.

Soplos System Service affiche l'état des services systemd de l'ordinateur et permet de les contrôler : démarrer, arrêter, redémarrer, activer et désactiver les services et minuteries, lire les journaux du système et par service, voir la durée du démarrage et ce qui le ralentit, et obtenir des suggestions sur ce dont cet ordinateur n'a pas besoin. Chaque modification est enregistrée dans un historique et peut être annulée. Une page de diagnostic indique ce qui est cassé et le répare avec apt, dpkg ou systemctl après avoir montré ce qui changera.

Soplos System Service zeigt den Zustand der systemd-Dienste des Computers und erlaubt deren Steuerung: Starten, Stoppen, Neustarten, Aktivieren und Deaktivieren von Diensten und Timern, Lesen der System- und Dienstprotokolle, Anzeigen der Bootdauer und was sie verlangsamt, sowie Vorschläge, was dieser Computer nicht benötigt. Jede Änderung wird im Verlauf gespeichert und kann rückgängig gemacht werden. Eine Diagnoseseite zeigt, was defekt ist, und repariert es mit apt, dpkg oder systemctl.

Soplos System Service mostra o estado dos serviços systemd do computador e permite controlá-los: iniciar, parar, reiniciar, ativar e desativar serviços e temporizadores, ler os registos do sistema e por serviço, ver quanto tempo demora o arranque e o que o atrasa, e obter sugestões sobre o que este computador não precisa. Cada alteração fica registada no histórico e pode ser desfeita. Uma página de diagnóstico indica o que está avariado e repara-o com apt, dpkg ou systemctl mostrando primeiro o que vai mudar.

Soplos System Service mostra lo stato dei servizi systemd del computer e consente di controllarli: avviare, fermare, riavviare, abilitare e disabilitare servizi e timer, leggere i log di sistema e per servizio, vedere quanto impiega l'avvio e cosa lo rallenta, e ottenere suggerimenti su ciò di cui questo computer non ha bisogno. Ogni modifica viene registrata nella cronologia e può essere annullata. Una pagina di diagnosi indica cosa è rotto e lo ripara con apt, dpkg o systemctl mostrando prima cosa cambierà.

Soplos System Service arată starea serviciilor systemd ale computerului și permite controlul lor: pornire, oprire, repornire, activare și dezactivare a serviciilor și timerelor, citirea jurnalelor de sistem și per serviciu, vizualizarea duratei de pornire și a cauzelor întârzierii, și sugestii despre ce nu are nevoie acest computer. Fiecare modificare este înregistrată în istoric și poate fi anulată. O pagină de diagnostic arată ce este defect și îl repară cu apt, dpkg sau systemctl după ce arată ce se va schimba.

Soplos System Service показывает состояние служб systemd компьютера и позволяет управлять ими: запускать, останавливать, перезапускать, включать и отключать службы и таймеры, читать системные журналы и журналы отдельных служб, видеть время загрузки и что её замедляет, а также получать рекомендации о том, что этому компьютеру не нужно. Каждое изменение записывается в историю и может быть отменено. Страница диагностики показывает, что сломано, и исправляет это с помощью apt, dpkg или systemctl, предварительно показывая, что изменится.

description.p: First stable release. Boot analysis can add the user to the systemd-journal group, so the history of the earlier boots is shown after restarting the session.
The application metadata points to the installed launcher, and the manual page is the same in the project and in the package.
The window no longer has the frame of the system: it is a card with rounded corners and its own minimize, maximize and close buttons.
New application icon, new hero image and new screenshots, taken with the interface in English.
The window follows the light or dark theme of the desktop (Xfce, Plasma and GNOME); the button of the sidebar still lets you choose.

ul.li: Four more screenshots (Diagnosis, Optimization, Boot analysis and History); the captions of the Timers and Logs screenshots corrected
AppStream categories and keywords in 8 languages; developer and project group identifiers now org.soplos
Manual page installed compressed; changelog installed to /usr/share/doc/soplos-system-service/
Debian copyright declares Lucide (ISC), used for the interface icons
Unix manual page added (soplos-system-service(1))
Screenshots packaged in /usr/share/doc/soplos-system-service/
Desktop entry and AppStream metainfo translated to 8 languages
README updated with architecture, shortcuts and build instructions

description.p: Orphaned services can now be found and removed.

ul.li: A service made from an autostart entry whose program is gone (for example an uninstalled Flatpak) is found and can be deleted, from Diagnosis and from the Services page
Links of systemd that point to nothing are found and deleted
A graphical system without its display manager link is found and repaired
Diagnosis also looks at the user's failed services
Diagnosis no longer reports a package as damaged because its translations were removed

description.p: Applying a selection on the Optimization page works again.

ul.li: Services that come with a socket or a path (such as the print service) can be turned off together with it
The sockets of units the system needs are protected like the units themselves

description.p: The Diagnosis page was rebuilt from scratch: it starts from what systemd and the package system report, not from the text of the log.

ul.li: Diagnosis says the system is working when no service has failed and no package is half-installed or has broken dependencies
Errors in the log with nothing wrong behind them are only counted, in a folded block
What is broken is explained with data measured on the computer: unit state, whether the program it starts exists, and whether the package that owns it is damaged
Repairs use Debian's own tools: reinstall a package, finish configuring packages, fix broken dependencies, restart or disable a unit
Messages Debian's logcheck lists as normal are recognized when logcheck-database is installed
